first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: An airborne person wearing a red-and-blue bodysuit and a red hood, with a light-colored pattern on the back, facing away from the camera.

entities.name: Cluster of city buildings
entities.identification: Densely packed reddish-brown and gray buildings on both sides of the road, with repeating window grids and flat roofs of varying heights.

entities.name: City street
entities.identification: The gray vertical road between the buildings and the horizontal road intersecting it in the lower part of the image.

entities.name: Neighborhood trees
entities.identification: A collection of green and yellow-green tree crowns distributed along both sides of the road and in open spaces between buildings.

entities.name: Street vehicles
entities.identification: Multiple light-colored, dark-colored, and a small number of yellow background vehicles on the vertical and horizontal roads.

entities.name: Building facade billboard
entities.identification: A collection of building-facade graphic and sign areas, including the large orange-brown graphic surface on the right in the first frame and the small yellow sign surface on the left in the final frame.
